create.channelMerchantNameRequired: Please enter the channel merchant name
create.channelMchNoRequired: Please enter the channel merchant no.

credential.title: Access Configuration
credential.isvNoTip: Must match the provider number in the mock gateway console merchant profile
credential.globalDesc: Mock channel gateway signing key, paired with the key on the mock gateway; channel-level global configuration applied to all mock merchants, development use only
credential.unconfiguredWarning: Gateway signing key is not configured; mock payment and callbacks are unavailable until configured
credential.gatewayBaseUrlPlaceholder: Enter the mock channel gateway URL
credential.gatewayBaseUrlTip: Base URL of the mock gateway; request URL = base URL + /v3/mock, the channel sub-application sends mock gateway requests to this address
credential.merchantPrivateKeyPlaceholder: Enter the merchant private key (PEM PKCS#8)
credential.merchantPrivateKeyRequired: Please paste the merchant private key
credential.platformPublicKeyPlaceholder: Enter the platform public key (PEM SPKI)
credential.platformPublicKeyRequired: Please paste the platform public key
credential.privateKeyTip: Merchant private key (PEM PKCS#8) for request signing; must pair with the merchant public key on the mock gateway
credential.publicKeyTip: Platform public key (PEM SPKI) for response and callback verification
credential.configuredTip: Configured; the field shows masked characters. Leave unchanged or blank to keep the current value
credential.unconfiguredTip: Not configured; paste the key from the mock gateway console (integration materials page)
credential.replacePrivateKeyContent: When replacing only the merchant private key, make sure it matches the key currently used by the mock gateway; otherwise requests from this subject will fail verification.

manage.cardBasicInfoDesc: View channel merchant basic registration info
manage.cardEditNameDesc: Change the display name of the channel merchant
manage.cardCredentialDesc: Merchant-level access key (gateway URL, merchant private key, platform public key); payments cannot be initiated until configured
manage.cardCredentialDescConfigured: Merchant-level access key (gateway URL, merchant private key, platform public key) is configured
manage.cardCredentialDescNotConfigured: Merchant-level access key (gateway URL, merchant private key, platform public key) is not configured; payments cannot be initiated until configured
manage.cardTerminalDesc: Register channel-side terminals for this channel merchant, bind and deregister

workbench.cardCredentialDesc: Gateway signing key of the mock channel; one global channel-level key shared by all mock merchants
workbench.cardChannelMerchantDesc: Open the global channel merchant list to view and manage merchants registered on the mock channel
workbench.cardPaySwitchDesc: Controls whether the provider can be used for new payments; refunds, close, query and callbacks are unaffected
workbench.confirmPayEnableContent: After enabling, new payment requests can use the mock service provider; refunds, close, query and callbacks are unaffected. Continue?
workbench.confirmPayDisableContent: After disabling, new payment requests cannot use the mock service provider; refunds, close, query and callbacks are unaffected. Continue?
